title: Donut Trellis — Per-Panel Hover Value Callout

complexity.rationale: Deliberately scoped narrow (split out at the user's request). Once donut-trellis-cross-panel-hover's shared hover signal exists, this is a single new text mark per panel, reusing existing color-resolution helpers (getColorProductionRule) and gated on an existing (soon-to-exist) signal - no new cross-cutting mechanism of its own, just one additional precedented-shape mark applied to each panel.

summary: When a category is hovered anywhere in a donut-trellis chart (via donut-trellis-cross-panel-hover's shared signal), each panel must display a new bold, categorically-colored percentage value above its own donut ring, reflecting that panel's own value for the hovered category. Confirmed via a live Figma reference: hovering 'Phone' shows a different bold purple percentage above each of the 5 region panels (65.2%/44.6%/67.9%/50.0%/55.6%), each computed independently from that panel's own data. This is a brand-new label mark (not persistent - only visible during hover) and depends on donut-trellis-cross-panel-hover's shared signal and donut-trellis's panel structure.
requirements: Add a new text mark positioned above each trellis panel's donut ring, showing that panel's own percentage value for whichever category is currently hovered (per donut-trellis-cross-panel-hover's shared signal) - bold weight, colored in that category's own categorical color (confirmed: the value renders in the same purple as the hovered Phone segment).
Only visible while a category is actively hovered somewhere in the trellis - hidden by default when nothing is hovered.

Each panel computes its own percentage independently (that panel's own total), not a chart-wide aggregate - confirmed by the differing values per region (65.2%/44.6%/67.9%/50.0%/55.6%) for the same hovered category (Phone).

edgeCases.case: Hovered category has 0% share in a given panel
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Undocumented - confirm whether that panel shows '0%' or hides the callout for that panel specifically.

edgeCases.case: Very long/wide value text in a tightly-packed grid
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Confirm the callout doesn't overlap neighboring panels at small panel sizes or narrow grid gutters.
Confirm the callout's font size follows the same per-tier model as other donut typography (donut-summary-responsive-sizing) rather than a separate fixed size.

edgeCases.case: Panel also shows a persistent DonutSummary in its center
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Confirm the callout (above the ring) and the summary (inside the hole) don't visually collide, especially at small panel sizes.

crossCutting.notes: requiresNewSignalOrScale is false - this reuses the shared hover signal donut-trellis-cross-panel-hover introduces, rather than adding another one; it only adds a new text mark reacting to that existing signal. requiresS1S2Parity is false: no existing s1 Donut trellis to mirror.

implementationPlan.change: Add a new text mark per panel, positioned above that panel's ring, gated on donut-trellis-cross-panel-hover's shared signal being non-null, computing that panel's own percentage for the hovered category and coloring it via getColorProductionRule to match.
